source.text: Cedar Junction Conversion Services, LLC and its Kentucky brownfield processing property are fictional. Its legal name, geography, personnel roles, seller figures and artifacts are derived case detail; none identifies a real licensee. Sable Harbor did not acquire or operate the property. The record depicts an abandoned transaction and confers no conversion authority.

source.text: Salt Rim Recovery Venture was a fictional proposal to restart a western uranium recovery operation through a seller/operating-partner arrangement. Dillon Severn, a fictional veteran uranium specialist, supplied its principal expert thesis. Names and details are synthetic. Neither the venture nor Severn is a disguised statement about a real company or individual.
